title: Dogens Intimate Practice
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett invites listeners to explore the idea that true awakening comes not from seeking inner peace or calmness, but from letting go of our sense of separation and individuality. This is a central teaching of Dogen, who suggests that enlightenment arises from understanding and releasing our attachment to the self, allowing us to connect more deeply with the world around us. By embracing this idea, we can experience a profound shift in our perception of reality, one that reveals the interconnectedness of all things and allows us to move forward with greater courage and joy.
